compiled_state.title: [review-coverage-lib]: rebase-merged PR sets merge_commit_sha to reviewed tip -> A3b guard excludes covering PR -> staged-tip (version-bump) SHA wrongly UNREVIEWED under enforce
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** b50e24177e87f622415417a6abd940fe6b8cf3d3 (go-live enforce-flip, story 3ee4)

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (surfaced during 3ee4 enforce-flip live-verification)

#### Expected Behavior
`rc_sha_is_reviewed` (plugins/dso/scripts/lib/review-coverage-lib.sh) proves a SHA reviewed when a covering MERGED PR carries a passing review check-run. A commit that is the rebased tip of a sub-PR (1 parent, patch-identical to the reviewed sub-PR content) MUST be recognized as reviewed via that covering PR.

#### Actual Behavior
After cca8 DD1 (rebase-not-merge), GitHub sets a rebase-merged PR's `merge_commit_sha` to the rebased TIP commit (a real 1-parent commit). Under `merge-to-main` that tip is always the version-bump commit. The A3b self-merge guard in rc_sha_is_reviewed (`if pr.get('merge_commit_sha') == sha_u: continue`) then EXCLUDES the covering PR, so the walk reports `no covering merged PR with a passing review check-run` and the SHA is UNREVIEWED.

Live evidence (PR #699, go-live PR2): `review-coverage-invariant: 2 SHA(s) ... verified=1 ... unreviewed=1`; UNREVIEWED b50e24177e (1 parent) == PR #698 merge_commit_sha; PR #698 review-sub-pr = success. review-gate (enforce) -> FAIL, 3 consecutive runs.

Systematic: every rebase-merged promotion's version-bump tip wedges PR2 under enforce.

A3b was written for merge-commit semantics (>=2-parent node whose combined diff the sub-PR review never saw). The fix: apply A3b only when sha_u is a genuine merge commit (>=2 parents); a 1-parent rebase/squash tip keeps its covering-PR proof (G3 re-verifies the review actually passed, so no laundering).

### 6. Logs
GH Actions run 27083383661 (review-gate), job 79933199923 / 79933496169 / 79933713875.
